blurb: Guests can dock their vessels at the marina with daily, weekly, or monthly rates based on vessel length. The marina offers pump-out services with a summer schedule and limited winter availability. Independent marine service contractors are available for boat maintenance and repairs.
extraNote: If cancelled more than 7 days prior to arrival date, refund shall be in full. · If cancellation is within 7 days of arrival date, Licensee shall receive a dockage credit in the same dollar amount to apply to future dockage within the same season, contingent on dockage availability. · There are no refunds for discounted, weekly, or monthly rates for early departure.
